scenes.title: How fast can a website be built *in 2026?*
scenes.say: How fast can a small business website actually be built in 2026?
scenes.cap: How fast can a website be built *in 2026?*

scenes.title: Then vs now
scenes.say: It used to take two or three months. Today, a simple five page site can go live in about a week.
scenes.cap: It used to take *months.* Now a simple site takes *about a week.*

items.say: Day one: a short call. What do customers need to find? That decides the pages.
Day two: the homepage design, built for phones first.
Days three and four: every page gets built. AI helps with first drafts, a human checks everything.
items.cap: AI helps with first drafts. *A human checks everything.*

items.say: Day five: booking, contact forms, and an optional chatbot.
Day six: speed tests, and connecting it to Google so people can find you.

scenes.title: What slows it down?
scenes.body: Waiting on *photos, text and logins.* Have them ready and a week is realistic.
scenes.say: The biggest delay? Waiting on photos, text and logins. Have those ready and a week is realistic.
scenes.cap: Biggest delay: waiting on *photos, text and logins.*
